title: Re:ZERO -Starting Life in Another World- TV Anime Gets 5th Season
content: Kadokawa revealed on Saturday at a 10th anniversary event for the Re:ZERO -Starting Life in Another World- anime that the anime will get a fifth season. The company also revealed an "ultra teaser visual" for the new season. Update: Replaced ultra teaser visual with English version.
author: ANN

title: Uzono Shiniko Hōkoku Manga Ends in 4th Volume
content: Kadokawa is listing the fourth volume of Gonbe Shinkawa 's Uzono Shiniko Hōkoku (Uzono Shiniko Report) manga as the final volume for the series. The volume will ship on January 7.
author: ANN

title: Odekake Kozame Anime Gets 2nd Film
content: The second episode of the online radio program SameRadi! announced on Sunday that the anime of Penguin Box 's Odekake Kozame (Little Shark's Outings) manga will have a second film.
author: ANN

title: WEBTOON CEO Junkoo Kim Receives Outstanding Contribution Award at Korea's 26th Cartoon Day Ceremony
content: WEBTOON Entertainment CEO Junkoo Kim received an outstanding contribution award for his contributions to the development of the webtoon industry at the 26th Cartoon Day ceremony, held on November 3 at the Korea Manhwa Museum in Bucheon, South Korea.
author: ANN

title: Stranger Than Heaven Game Streams Story Trailer for 2nd Act 'Kure'
content: Sega began streaming a story trailer for Ryu ga Gotoku Studio's Stranger Than Heaven game (previously codenamed "Project Century") on Friday. The video outlines the game's second act "Kure," and highlights the protagonist Makoto Daito's life in 1929 in Kure. A previous trailer outlined the game's first act.
author: ANN

title: MyGO and Ave Mujica Anime Sequel Unveils 2nd Trailer Featuring MyGO
content: A second trailer was unveiled for the upcoming anime sequel to MyGO and Ave Mujica, titled BanG Dream! MyGO!!!!! // Ave Mujica . The latest trailer mainly features the MyGO and the anime is slated to premiere on January 8, 2027. An Ave Mujica focused video was previously released last month.
author: Anime Corner

title: RetroCrush Streams Sugar Sugar Rune, Genocyber Anime
content: The service has also now added many of the titles it had announced in August that it was adding from Viz Media , including: Vampire Knight , Accel World , Naruto the Movie: Ninja Clash in the Land of Snow , Sailor Moon R: The Movie , Bleach the Movie: Hell Verse , and Captain Tsubasa .
author: ANN

title: Bride of the Barrier Master Anime Streams Video for Hana's Twin Hazuki Ichise
content: The staff for the television anime of Kureha 's Bride of the Barrier Master ( Kekkaishi no Ichirinka ) light novel series started streaming the character promotional video for Hana's twin sister Hazuki Ichise (as voiced by Kanon Takao ) on Sunday.
author: ANN

title: MAGES Develops Girls und Panzer Mahjong Game For PS5, Switch 2
content: MAGES revealed the title, release window, and teaser video on Saturday for the "new consumer game " it is developing for the Girls und Panzer franchise. The "tag strike mahjong" game is titled Girls & Panzer Hakunetsu! Mahjong Tag Battle Desu! (Girls & Panzer Heating Up!
author: ANN

title: Even the Student Council Has It's Holes! Anime Casts Yōko Hikasa
content: The staff for the television anime of Muchimaro 's Even the Student Council Has Its Holes! ( Seitokai ni mo Ana wa Aru! ) four-panel manga confirmed on Sunday that Yōko Hikasa plays Masaki Kotobuki, Hisako Kotobuki's mother who appeared in episode 7 this weekend.
author: ANN
